claims.claim: Original LLaVA uses CLIP ViT-L/14, a linear projection and Vicuna; visual embeddings are continuous vectors of LLM embedding width
Text-only GPT-4 receives COCO captions and bounding boxes, not image pixels, to generate visual instructions
claims.locator: Section 3, Table 1, PDF pp3-4; Appendix F pp22-25

claims.claim: 158K examples: 58K conversations, 23K detailed descriptions, 77K complex reasoning
Stage 1 trains only W on 595K filtered CC3M pairs; stage 2 trains W and LLM while image encoder remains frozen
Autoregressive loss is applied only to assistant answer and stop tokens
CC-595K uses 1 epoch, lr .002, batch128; chat uses 3 epochs, lr .00002, batch32; Adam, cosine decay, 3% warmup
COCO benchmark uses 30 images and90 questions; full/only-conversation/no-instruction relative scores are85.1/73.8/21.5
claims.qualification: Relative GPT-4-judge score, not task accuracy or percentage of general GPT-4 ability

claims.claim: In-the-Wild uses24 images and60 questions; LLaVA67.3±2.0, BLIP-238.1±1.0, OpenFlamingo19.1±.4
claims.qualification: Different benchmark difficulty and a small sample; decoding variability is not complete evaluator validation

claims.claim: ScienceQA accuracy90.92 for LLaVA alone and92.53 for LLaVA+text-only GPT-4 judge ensemble
Best13B90.92; skip alignment85.81; 7B89.84; last-layer visual features89.96
claims.qualification: Answer-first ablation is shown under last-layer column; do not attribute all table deltas to isolated CoT effect

claims.claim: Strawberries plus yogurt may be incorrectly bound into strawberry-flavored yogurt; fine-detail/high-resolution failures observed
No action-conditioned transition, reward model or control-loop evaluation in this paper
claims.locator: Architecture and objectives in Sections4-5; analyst boundary inference

claims.claim: 224/14 gives 256 grid features of width 1024 (CLIP ViT-L/14); Vicuna-13B embedding width 5120 (LLaMA-13B); W is 5120x1024, about 5.24M parameters
claims.locator: Computed; CLIP arXiv:2103.00020 Table 20; LLaMA arXiv:2302.13971 Table 2

claims.claim: Table 4 rows: full 85.1, detail+complex 81.9, conv+5% detail+10% complex 80.5, conversation only 73.8, no instruction tuning 21.5; authors say LLaVA sometimes perceives the image as a bag of patches (strawberry yogurt failure)
Penultimate-layer features 90.92 vs last layer 89.96 on ScienceQA; authors hypothesize the last layer focuses on global abstract properties

Follow-up POPE on COCO: LLaVA random accuracy 54.43 with 95.37% yes; adversarial 50.77 with 99.10% yes; InstructBLIP 88.73/74.37; synthetic instructions from text-only LLMs may contain descriptions inconsistent with the image

Follow-up LLaVA-1.5: original LLaVA weak on short-answer benchmarks and biased to yes; adding VQAv2 plus format prompt raises MME 809.6 to 1323.8; MLP connector, 336px CLIP, academic data, 13B; 1.2M public data, about 1 day on one 8-A100 node; POPE F1 rand/pop/adv 76.3/72.2/70.1 (LLaVA-7B) vs 87.1/86.2/84.5 (LLaVA-1.5-13B); LLaVA-Instruct details may contain hallucinations and 448 resolution reduces them; limitations include no multi-image
claims.locator: arXiv:2310.03744v2 abstract, Sections 1, 3.1-3.3, 5.2, Tables 2 and 4, Appendix C

claims.claim: Follow-up Qwen-VL: single-layer cross-attention adapter compresses to 256 tokens; stage 1 on 1.4B cleaned pairs freezes the LLM and trains vision encoder and adapter; stage 2 at 448x448 unlocks the LLM; boxes normalized to [0,1000) as text. InternVL scales the vision encoder to 6B (InternViT-6B)
